narration:
A Working Visit

The house had been empty, but in this telling a promising connection, weak support, and a costly demo were already present. Then someone returned and removed their coat, and a request to “show me” came with objections exchanged. Research began within her permissions and resource budget. She separated the promising idea from the unreliable implementation, leaving the implementation doubted and a qualified note in hand. She waited until he had taken off his coat, then offered the note. “Show me,” he said, and they entered a discussion. At the same time, they revised the work together, and the conclusion belonged to neither participant at the beginning: objections were exchanged, the initial approach was abandoned, and a better question emerged, making the research useful. In the end, a better question, doubted implementation, abandoned initial approach, research permission, useful research, shared interest, and clear tasks all remained.

Narrator's note: Beat 1 held five environment events, summarized as the opening conditions. Beat 6 held one event.
